name: count
title: Count
description: The one counter: a number that counts to its new value when it changes, so a syncing source's documents visibly climb. Reduced motion shows the new value at once.
use_for: Numbers that change while the person watches: documents, rows read, the amount of the row pointed at.
never: Numbers that never change on the page
A count that rolls on every visit: use `once`
body: It eases to each new `value` over 700ms. `rolls` counts up from zero as it lands; `once="key"` does that only the first time the key shows in the tab's session. `format` reads it as an amount or a share (a function from the number to its text); plain counts get thousands separators. Figures are tabular, so the width holds.
